{{Quote|So you thought you could hide your deal with the offworlders from me, droid? I'm tired of not getting my cut! Turn him into a scrap heap, boys!|Ganga Lor|<ref name="TTG" />}}
'''Ganga Lor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] residing on [[Sel Zonn Station]], an [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. Lor was a longtime enemy of the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] crime lord [[Switch]], who had arrived at Sel Zonn Station at the same time as Lor.<ref name="TTG" />

At some point during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Ganga Lor discovered Switch negotiating with some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in [[Deep Storage Bay V14]] for an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Suspended animation/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. Angry that he had been left out, he ordered his men to open fire on Switch and the spacers.<ref name="TTG" />
{{RPG}}
Switch's [[Thug/Legends|thugs]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] had been paid before not to shoot Ganga Lor's thugs. During the fight, Switch's thugs turned on him and began fighting with Ganga Lor. However, the spacers were able to dispatch the turncoats, and Switch was protected.<ref name="TTG" />
{{Endgame}}
Switch survived the fight,<ref name="AWH">{{DoD|A Wretched Hive (adventure)}}</ref> though Ganga Lor did not.<ref name="TTG" />
